read.thesis: Q3 revenue $46.7B (+16.2% QoQ) beat guidance; FY26 growth raised to ~44% USD and 2026-28 capex flagged well above the past three years, with N3 capacity added despite stated no-add policy.

capex.quote: we continue to expect our CapEx investment from 2026 to 2028 to be even more significantly higher than the past three years

triggers.label: N3 capacity added despite no-add policy
triggers.quote: historically, we do not add additional capacity to a node once it reaches its targeted capacity.

triggers.label: 2026-28 capex well above past three years
triggers.quote: our CapEx investment from 2026 to 2028 to be even more significantly higher than the past three years

triggers.label: FY26 USD growth raised to ~44%
triggers.quote: we now expect our full year 2026 revenue growth to be around 44% year-over-year in U.S. dollar term

triggers.label: Overseas GM dilution widens to 3-4%
triggers.quote: we expect the dilution from our overseas fabs to widen to 3%-4% in the next few years

triggers.label: Consumer segments challenged
triggers.quote: consumer and price-sensitive end market segment are being challenged due to the impact of rising component prices

guidance.quote: we now expect our full year 2026 revenue growth to be around 44% year-over-year in U.S. dollar term
we expect our fourth quarter revenue to be between $52.3 billion and $54.3 billion
gross margin is expected to be between 65% and 67%, operating margin between 56.5% and 58.5%
we reiterate our full year 2026 capital budget to be between $60 billion and $64 billion

guidance.value: 3%-4% in later part of five-year period
